errors.evidence: The description assigns many category-color/value pairings incorrectly. In the figure, the large left pie has categories like 生活工作 23.3%, 生产 16.91%, 身体动作 9.9%, 社交 6.6%, 生理活动 9.48%, 文教 5.57%, 战争 8.87%, and 其他 19.38%. The smaller right pie has 物态事态 23.4%, 心理活动 10.64%, 司法 10.64%, 判断 8.51%, 交通 4.26%, 际遇 5.32%, 方位改变 18.09%, 表情 5.32%, 帮助 4.26%, and 争斗 9.57%. The machine text misplaces several categories and colors, e.g. it treats 物态事态 as the largest overall slice and maps colors inconsistently with the legend.
